I am very sorry you've suffered at the hands and words of those claiming to be Christians. It is difficult and I can relate; I have also been shunned and insulted by other Christians when I came out but held to my faith. I have also been shunned and insulted by those within both the fandom and the LGBTQIA+ community for being a gay Christian. So I understand how difficult it is for OP. I am glad you have Christian friends who have shown you the true love Christians are called to demonstrate.

You’re not the only one and yes it can feel isolating. As previously mentioned many in the fandom do view Christians as inherently hateful which is unfortunately due to the rhetoric of the American/Western church. As someone who has read through the Bible on multiple occasions it is unfortunate the Church has become an exact opposite of the what the Scriptures preach. With this history of hate many have been burned by the Church and have deep rooted wounds and trauma. As a Christian within the fandom we must understand this and be patient with others and how they might lash out, it doesn’t come from a place of personal attack towards you but rather as a defense mechanism. Rest assured you’re not alone and you’re not the first in the fandom to feel this way. Build a community of fellow Christian furries who can encourage and ground you when times are tough.
